en.quote: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
en.riddle: the posts of the door moved at the voice
en.speaker: the voice

he.quote: וַיָּנֻעוּ אַמּוֹת הַסִּפִּים מִקּוֹל הַקּוֹרֵא וְהַבַּיִת יִמָּלֵא עָשָֽׁן
he.speaker: הַקּוֹרֵא
